name: Dumbbell Incline Neutral-Grip Bench Press
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline and lie back with feet planted flat.
Hold a dumbbell beside each side of your chest with palms facing each other.
Press both dumbbells straight upward until your arms extend above your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells slowly beside your chest while keeping the handles parallel.
tips: Keep your elbows directly beneath your wrists throughout the press.
Keep your shoulder blades anchored against the bench without shrugging upward.
